findings_summary.finding: The managed router diagnostic and log surfaces can retain only RelayBackendError for several materially different upstream failures.
findings_summary.concrete_input_or_state: A routed image request fails after 13.876 seconds and the next OCR request fails after 0.146 seconds, while engine logs show no model error; identical direct requests and later identical routed requests pass without a configuration or runtime mutation.
findings_summary.wrong_result: Operators cannot determine whether the failure occurred during connect, header receipt, upstream status, body read, JSON parsing, response-size enforcement, or SSE completion.
findings_summary.required_resolution: Track this as a product ticket. Emit a bounded, secret-safe relay failure phase and sanitized upstream status or exception class keyed by gateway_request_id; never log request bodies, response bodies, URLs, or credentials.

observations: The first routed thinking-enabled image and OCR pair failed with HTTP 500 and backend_error_RelayBackendError.
The same image and OCR requests passed directly with thinking enabled and a 10240 completion cap.
The identical routed image and OCR retry also passed with no intervening configuration or runtime mutation.
The two failures therefore do not establish a stable multimodal, reasoning, output-cap, or model incompatibility.

breakage_probes.wrong_result: A malformed result is returned as success.
breakage_probes.classification: refuted; the router fails closed with HTTP 500

advisory_priors: The existing bounded diagnostic sequence is router diagnose by gateway request ID, bounded router logs for the same time window, and managed engine logs. Those surfaces were used and expose no deeper retained cause here.
Do not change the model recipe, reasoning policy, media limits, or output cap based on this unreproduced incident.

recommendation.reason: Direct and routed retries pass the identical requests without mutation, so the failure is intermittent and does not overturn the qualified C1 model contract. Preserve both failures and passes, disclose that root cause is unresolved, and open the observability ticket.
recommendation.bounded_remaining_action: No additional live sweep is required for acceptance; retain normal health monitoring and use the improved diagnostic seam if the incident recurs.
